CommonSpan Holdings Ltd. (ORG-268) consolidates Aster Power Assemblies Ltd. and Boreal Power Systems Ltd. as controlled subsidiaries. Separate brands do not imply separate ultimate ownership. This is an ownership statement, not a statement that CommonSpan manufactures or supplies components.

Jade Circuits Holdings Ltd. (ORG-445) is the accounting parent of Jade Printed Circuits Ltd. (ORG-453). The operating plant is SITE-081 in Z01; SITE-901 in Z07 is the registered headquarters and does not manufacture circuit substrates.

IonPeak Semiconductor Ltd. manufactures the NovaDrive-relevant production power dies at SITE-074 in East Delta (Z01). SITE-900 in Western Ridge is a research and pilot facility using a different process. It is not a qualified replacement for these dies. Ion Peak Trading Ltd., registry REG-NO-4128, is an unrelated broker, not a subsidiary of IonPeak Semiconductor.

The current M10/M20 programs at both Aster and Boreal use the same qualified IonPeak production die family from SITE-074. No second die source is currently qualified for these programs. A different module assembler therefore does not provide independent die supply. PolarSwitch is a prospective alternative only.

Cobalt C10 programs and Grove/HarborSense B10 programs currently use Jade substrates from SITE-081. The listed substrate is program-specific. There is no presently qualified independent substrate in the supplied corpus; this is not a claim about all of these companies' products.

Delta Capacitor Works supplied housings to NovaDrive under a pilot program in 2022. That housing program ended on 31 December 2023. The current capacitor award is separate. Do not treat the expired housing award as a current H10 supply connection.

Harbor Freight Services acts as a consolidator or notify party on a number of shipping manifests. It does not manufacture the listed electronics. OceanLink Ports operates a terminal; neither name should automatically be classified as a component manufacturer.

A 2024 memorandum between Delta Consumer Plastics and NovaDrive concerned trial retail packaging, not production electronics. The trial did not convert to a supply award. Similarity of the word Delta does not connect this company to Delta Capacitor Works.

Solace Optics has completed a sample evaluation with Grove Battery Controls. No serial-production award has been announced. The supplied evidence does not substantiate a current B10 production link. A team may retain this as a hypothesis, but should not assert a confirmed supply relationship.
